title: Chicken, Bacon & Mushroom Risotto
description: Amounts estimated and scaled to 4 serves. Taste a grain near the end and adjust.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Amounts estimated and scaled to 4 serves.

items.note: Plus a cold knob to finish

steps.text: Grate the parmesan ({{parmesan}}) 10 sec / Speed 9. Set aside.
Add the onion ({{onion}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) and bacon ({{bacon}}). Chop 4 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.
Add the butter ({{butter}}) and oil ({{oil}}). Sauté 5 min / 120°C / Speed 1.
Insert the butterfly. Add the rice ({{rice}}) and wine ({{wine}}), sauté 3 min / 120°C / Reverse / Speed 1 with the MC off. Scrape the bowl base so nothing catches.
Add the stock ({{stock}}) and chicken ({{chicken}}), not the mushrooms. Do not exceed the MAX line. Cook 18 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, MC off.
Sear the mushrooms ({{mushrooms}}) separately in a hot pan so they brown rather than steam.
Stir through half the parmesan ({{parmesan*0.5}}), the salt ({{salt}}), pepper ({{pepper}}) and a cold knob of butter off the heat. Rest 5 minutes.
Fold the seared mushrooms through. Finish with lemon, parsley and blistered cherry tomatoes.

notes.title: Butter off heat
notes.text: The cold knob goes in with the heat off. It emulsifies rather than splits.

notes.title: Dry white wine
notes.text: Sauvignon blanc, pinot grigio or an unoaked chardonnay. If you would rather not open a bottle, use extra stock plus a squeeze of lemon.

notes.title: Zucchini
notes.text: Optional. Add it in the last 5–6 minutes, or sear it separately with the mushrooms.

notes.title: Herbs
notes.text: Dried thyme is the best match for mushroom and bacon.
